title: Untitled Discourses on Greed, Etc.
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 6 Numbered Discourses 6.143–169
  • 13. Rāgapeyyāla 13. Abbreviated Texts Beginning with Greed

~ Untitled Discourses on Greed, Etc.

“Rāgassa, bhikkhave, pariññāya …pe… “For the complete understanding of greed … parikkhayāya … complete ending … pahānāya … giving up … khayāya … ending … vayāya … vanishing … virāgāya … fading away … nirodhāya … cessation … cāgāya … giving away … paṭinissaggāya cha dhammā bhāvetabbā”. letting go of greed these six things should be developed.”
